description: Zonas protección aves líneas eléctricas is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Servicio de Espacios Naturales, Flora y Fauna de la Consejería de Medio Ambiente, Vivienda y Ordenación del Territorio. Junta de Castilla y León. Protection zones for avifauna against LAAT collision and electrocution in Castilla y León. Cartographic delimitation of protection zones for avifauna against collision and electrocution on high-voltage power lines in accordance with Order MAM/1628/2010 of 16 November 2010 delimiting and publishing protection zones for avifauna in which measures to safeguard against collision and electrocution on high-voltage ... Coverage: Servicio de Espacios Naturales, Flora y Fauna de la Consejería de Medio Ambiente, Vivienda y Ordenación del Territorio. Junta de Castilla y León. The portal shows the English title as "Bird Protection Areas Power Lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Servicio de Espacios Naturales, Flora y Fauna de la Consejería de Medio Ambiente, Vivienda y Ordenación del Territorio. Junta de Castilla y León. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2023-05-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
